## Event kinds

| kind | description | data fields |
|---|---|---|
| `run.done` | A tool run finished successfully. | `run_id`, `tool`, `status`, `duration_ms` |
| `run.failed` | A tool run ended in an error. | `run_id`, `tool`, `status`, `error_code` |
| `run.progress` | A running tool wrote a progress update. | `run_id`, `tool`, `progress` |
| `inbox.message` | A message arrived in the tenant's inbox. | `message_id`, `channel`, `from` |
| `table.changed` | A row was appended to, updated in or deleted from a table. | `table`, `op`, `row_id` |
| `state.changed` | A state key was set or deleted. | `key`, `op` |
| `queue.drained` | A queue went empty after being non-empty. | `queue` |
| `queue.dead_letter` | A queue item exhausted its attempts and moved to dead letters. | `queue`, `item_id`, `attempts` |
| `trigger.fired` | A trigger fired; data.trigger_kind says which sort. | `trigger_id`, `trigger_kind` |
| `tool.published` | A tool was published or republished. | `tool`, `version` |

## Queue states

| state | description |
|---|---|
| `active` | Accepting and delivering items. |
| `paused` | Accepting items; delivery is held. |
| `draining` | Refusing new items; delivering what remains. |
| `drained` | Empty and refusing new items. |
